Just a quick question, can a minion Freak Drive twice in the same
turn. I know that they can't use the same action mod more than once per
action and can't perform the same action type more than once, but can a
minion hunt, freak drive, then rescue a minion from torpor and freak
drive again to bleed?

I am pretty sure yes, but I need an official answer. thanks

jon

I'm not official but..

Yes, you canuse Freak Drive more than once per turn, but only once on an
action. The set of actions you give is perfectly legal since all three
are distinct actions. It was cards like Freak Drive and Rutor's Hand
that gave rise to the no-repeat actions rule, because you'd do a huge
bleed, untap, do it again and so on.
